    12	/-!
    13	# Rational-point residue bridge for the translated cover
    14	
    15	The density oracle used by the translated-cover drop has to record residue degree one at the
    16	chosen points.  This file supplies that arithmetic bridge from the actual section certificate,
    17	rather than adding `residueDeg = 1` as an unrelated existential field.  The relative specialization
    18	is the exact point produced by `Over.rationalPointBaseChange`.
    19	-/
    20	
    21	set_option autoImplicit false
    22	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    23	
    24	universe u
    25	
    26	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    27	open TopologicalSpace Opposite
    28	
    29	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    30	
    31	open AlgebraicJacobian
    32	
    33	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    34	
    35	/-! ## Sections have residue degree one -/
    36	
    37	theorem residueDeg_one_of_section
    38	    {K : Type u} [Field K]
    39	    {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))}
    40	    {e : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ X.left}
    41	    (he : e ≫ X.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    42	    {x : X.left}
    43	    (hx : e.base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) = x) :
    44	    X.left.residueDeg K x = 1 := by
    45	  letI : Algebra K (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) := stalkAlgebra X.hom x
    46	  have h := bijective_algebraMap_residueField_of_section X he hx
    47	  have hmap :
    48	      algebraMap K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)) =
    49	        X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap K x := by
    50	    ext c
    51	    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    52	      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)),
    53	      IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_eq, Scheme.residueOverAlgebraMap,
    54	      algebraMap_overStalkAlgebra]
    55	    simp [stalkStructureHom, Scheme.overAlgebraMap]
    56	    rfl
    57	  letI : Algebra K (X.left.residueField x) :=
    58	    (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap K x).toAlgebra
    59	  unfold Scheme.residueDeg
    60	  change Module.finrank K (X.left.residueField x) = 1
    61	  apply Module.finrank_of_bijective_algebraMap
    62	  change Function.Bijective (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap K x)
    63	  rw [← hmap]
    64	  exact h
    65	
    66	/-! ## The base-changed rational point is such a section -/
    67	
    68	theorem residueDeg_one_of_rationalPointBaseChange
    69	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    70	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    71	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    72	    (p : Spec (.of k) ⟶ C.left)
    73	    (hp : p ≫ C.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) :
    74	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).residueDeg L
    75	      ((Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint L)) = 1 := by
    76	  apply residueDeg_one_of_section
    77	    (X := Over.mk (snd C (overSpec k L)).left)
    78	    (e := Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp)
    79	  · exact Over.rationalPointBaseChange_snd C L p hp
    80	  · rfl
    81	
    82	/-- The graph point of a field-valued point has residue degree one. -/
    83	theorem residueDeg_one_of_graphPoint
    84	    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    85	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    86	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    87	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    88	    (t : overSpec k K ⟶ C) :
    89	    (C ⊗ overSpec k K).left.residueDeg K (Over.graphPoint C t) = 1 := by
    90	  exact residueDeg_one_of_section
    91	    (X := Over.mk (snd C (overSpec k K)).left)
    92	    (e := (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left)
    93	    (by
    94	      exact congrArg (fun q : overSpec k K ⟶ overSpec k K => q.left)
    95	        (Over.sectionOfPoint_snd t))
    96	    (by
    97	      change (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left.base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) =
    98	        (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left.base default
    99	      exact congrArg (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left.base
   100	        (Subsingleton.elim _ _))
   101	
   102	/-- The graph presentation has multiplicity one at its graph point.
   103	
   104	`presentationDivisor_graphLocalEquations` initially records the multiplicity as an order.
   105	The graph class and its residue field both have degree one, so the degree formula forces that
   106	order to be one.  This is the pointwise input for finite-support class descent below. -/
   107	theorem graphPicClass_eq_picClass_single
   108	    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   109	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   110	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   111	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   112	    (t : overSpec k K ⟶ C) :
   113	    Over.graphPicClass C t =
   114	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K
   115	        (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single (graphPoint_ne_genericPoint C t) 1) := by
   116	  let hx := graphPoint_ne_genericPoint C t
   117	  let a : ℤ :=
   118	    Multiplicative.toAdd
   119	      (Scheme.ordZ ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
   120	        hx ((Over.graphLocalEquations C t).presentation.elem (Over.graphPoint C t)))
   121	  have hsingle :
   122	      Scheme.presentationDivisor K (Over.graphLocalEquations C t).presentation =
   123	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.single hx a := by
   124	    exact presentationDivisor_graphLocalEquations C t
   125	  have hclass :
   126	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single hx a) =
   127	        Over.graphPicClass C t := by
   128	    rw [← hsingle, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_presentationDivisor K,
   129	      Scheme.LocalEquations.presentation_picClass]
   130	    rfl
   131	  have hdeg := classDeg_graphPicClass C t
   132	  rw [← hclass, classDeg_picClass, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_single'] at hdeg
   133	  rw [residueDeg_one_of_graphPoint C t, Nat.cast_one, mul_one] at hdeg
   134	  rw [hdeg] at hclass
   135	  exact hclass.symm
   136	
   137	/-! ## Image-set packaging -/
   138	
   139	theorem residueDeg_one_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChange_image
   140	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
   141	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   142	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   143	    (P : Set (relCurve C L))
   144	    (hP : ∀ x ∈ P, ∃ (p : Spec (.of k) ⟶ C.left)
   145	      (hp : p ≫ C.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k))),
   146	      (Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint L) = x) :
   147	    ∀ x ∈ P, (relCurve C L).residueDeg L x = 1 := by
   148	  intro x hx
   149	  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := hP x hx
   150	  rw [← hpx]
   151	  exact residueDeg_one_of_rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp
   152	
   153	/-! ## The dense point image used by the drop oracle -/
   154	
   155	/-- The points obtained by base-changing actual `k`-rational sections of `C` to `L`.
   156	
   157	The section certificate is retained in the membership predicate, so later consumers can recover
   158	the base point and its exact residue-degree proof.  This is deliberately an image set, rather
   159	than an existential carrier unrelated to the chosen curve and extension. -/
   160	def rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   161	    {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   162	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] : Set (relCurve C L) :=
   163	  {x | ∃ (p : Spec (.of k) ⟶ C.left)
   164	      (hp : p ≫ C.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k))),
   165	      (Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).base
   166	        (IsLocalRing.closedPoint L) = x}
   167	
   168	/-- Base-changed `k`-rational points are dense over a separably closed base. -/
   169	theorem dense_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   170	    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k]
   171	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   172	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   173	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsIntegral C.left]
   174	    (U : (relCurve C L).Opens)
   175	    (hU : (U : Set (relCurve C L)).Nonempty) :
   176	    (rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L ∩ U).Nonempty := by
   177	  obtain ⟨p, hp, hmem⟩ := Over.dense_baseChange_rationalPoints C L U hU
   178	  exact ⟨_, ⟨⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, hmem⟩⟩
   179	
   180	/-- Every point in the dense image has residue degree one, by its retained section certificate. -/
   181	theorem residueDeg_one_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage'
   182	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
   183	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   184	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
   185	    ∀ x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L,
   186	      (relCurve C L).residueDeg L x = 1 := by
   187	  intro x hx
   188	  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := hx
   189	  rw [← hpx]
   190	  exact residueDeg_one_of_rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp
   191	
   192	/-! ## Class descent for divisors supported on the rational-point image -/
   193	
   194	/-- Every point in the rational-point image is non-generic.  The retained section certificate
   195	identifies it with an actual graph point, where `graphPoint_ne_genericPoint` applies. -/
   196	theorem ne_genericPoint_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   197	    {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   198	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   199	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   200	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
   201	    ∀ x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L,
   202	      x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left := by
   203	  intro x hx
   204	  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := hx
   205	  rw [← hpx]
   206	  let q : overSpec k k ⟶ C := Over.homMk p (by
   207	    rw [overSpec_self_hom]
   208	    exact hp)
   209	  change Over.graphPoint C
   210	      (Over.overSpecMap (Algebra.ofId k L) ≫ q) ≠
   211	        genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left
   212	  exact graphPoint_ne_genericPoint C _
   213	
   214	/-- The one-point divisor at a base-changed rational point is the base change of a class on the
   215	base curve.  This is deliberately a class statement: no pullback operation on Weil divisors is
   216	needed. -/
   217	theorem exists_baseClass_picClass_single_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   218	    {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   219	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   220	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   221	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   222	    (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   223	    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   224	    (hmem : x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L) :
   225	    ∃ c : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   226	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single hx 1) =
   227	        Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) c := by
   228	  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := hmem
   229	  let q : overSpec k k ⟶ C := Over.homMk p (by
   230	    rw [overSpec_self_hom]
   231	    exact hp)
   232	  change Over.graphPoint C
   233	      (Over.overSpecMap (Algebra.ofId k L) ≫ q) = x at hpx
   234	  subst x
   235	  refine ⟨Over.graphPicClass C q, ?_⟩
   236	  rw [← graphPicClass_eq_picClass_single C]
   237	  exact graphPicClass_base_of_field C L q
   238	
   239	/-- A divisor whose finite support consists of base-changed rational points has a Picard class
   240	defined over the base field.
   241	
   242	The proof folds the pointwise graph-class identity over the divisor's `Finsupp` support.  It
   243	works for arbitrary integer multiplicities; effectivity and the prescribed drop degree are
   244	orthogonal hypotheses used by the greedy reduction, not by class descent. -/
   245	theorem exists_baseClass_of_supported_on_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   246	    {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   247	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   248	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   249	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   250	    (S : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor)
   251	    (hsupp : ∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   252	      (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left),
   253	      coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L) :
   254	    ∃ c : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   255	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   256	        Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) c := by
   257	  suffices hmain : ∀ f : {x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
   258	      x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left} →₀ ℤ,
   259	      (∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   260	        (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left),
   261	        coeffAt hx f ≠ 0 → x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L) →
   262	      ∃ c : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   263	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L f =
   264	          Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) c from hmain S hsupp
   265	  intro f
   266	  induction f using Finsupp.induction with
   267	  | zero =>
   268	      intro _
   269	      refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
   270	      change Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L
   271	        (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor) =
   272	          Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) 1
   273	      rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_zero, map_one]
   274	      rfl
   275	  | single_add p b f hpf hb ih =>
   276	      intro hsupport
   277	      have hfp : f p = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hpf
   278	      have hpMem : p.1 ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L := by
   279	        apply hsupport p.1 p.2
   280	        change (Finsupp.single p b + f) p ≠ 0
   281	        rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same, hfp, add_zero]
   282	        exact hb
   283	      have hfSupport : ∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   284	          (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left),
   285	          coeffAt hx f ≠ 0 → x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L := by
   286	        intro x hx hfx
   287	        apply hsupport x hx
   288	        change (Finsupp.single p b + f) ⟨x, hx⟩ ≠ 0
   289	        have hxp : (⟨x, hx⟩ : {z : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
   290	            z ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left}) ≠ p := by
   291	          intro heq
   292	          subst p
   293	          exact hfx hfp
   294	        rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hxp, zero_add]
   295	        exact hfx
   296	      obtain ⟨cp, hcp⟩ :=
   297	        exists_baseClass_picClass_single_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   298	          C p.1 p.2 hpMem
   299	      have key : ∀ D : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor,
   300	          (∃ cf : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   301	            Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L D =
   302	              Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) cf) →
   303	          ∃ c : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   304	            Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L
   305	              (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single p.2 b + D) =
   306	              Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) c := by
   307	        intro D hD
   308	        obtain ⟨cf, hcf⟩ := hD
   309	        refine ⟨cp ^ b * cf, ?_⟩
   310	        unfold relCurveMap relCurve at hcp hcf ⊢
   311	        rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_add,
   312	          ← Scheme.picClass_single_zpow L p.2 b, hcp, hcf, map_mul, map_zpow]
   313	      exact key f (ih hfSupport)
   314	
   315	/-- Exact discharge of `SepClosedTranslatedDropData.baseSubtraction` for the rational-point
   316	image.  The descended class is re-presented by an actual base-field divisor `Z`; at exponent
   317	zero, the inverse of `chartTwistClass C 0 Z` is precisely `picClass k Z`. -/
   318	theorem exists_baseSubtraction_of_supported_on_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   319	    {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   320	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   321	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   322	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   323	    (S : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor)
   324	    (hsupp : ∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   325	      (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left),
   326	      coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L) :
   327	    ∃ Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor,
   328	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   329	        Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   330	          ((chartTwistClass C 0 Z)⁻¹) := by
   331	  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
   332	    exists_baseClass_of_supported_on_rationalPointBaseChangeImage C S hsupp
   333	  obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ := Scheme.CurveDivisor.exists_picClass_eq k c
   334	  refine ⟨Z, ?_⟩
   335	  rw [hc]
   336	  apply congrArg
   337	  simp only [chartTwistClass, pow_zero, one_mul]
   338	  rw [hZ]
   339	  exact (inv_inv c).symm
   340	
   341	/-! ## The separably-closed drop package -/
   342	
   343	section DropPackage
   344	
   345	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k]
   346	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   347	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   348	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   349	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   350	  [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
   351	  [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
   352	
   353	/-- Build the translated-drop package using the actual dense image of base-field rational
   354	points.  Density, non-genericity, residue degree one, and the base-subtraction class identity
   355	are derived here; only the lambda-tied positive-twist divisor and its degree/vanishing data
   356	remain inputs. -/
   357	noncomputable def sepClosedTranslatedDropDataOfRationalPointImage
   358	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   359	    (m : ℕ)
   360	    (M₀ : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
   361	    (hM₀ : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ) =
   362	      PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M₀))
   363	    (W₀ : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor)
   364	    (hW₀ : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W₀ =
   365	      M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   366	        (chartTwistClass C m (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)))
   367	    (excess : ℕ)
   368	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ = (genus C : ℤ) + excess)
   369	    (h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   370	      ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W₀) 1)) :
   371	    SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ where
   372	  m := m
   373	  M₀ := M₀
   374	  hM₀ := hM₀
   375	  W₀ := W₀
   376	  hW₀ := hW₀
   377	  genusValue := genus C
   378	  excess := excess
   379	  hχ := chi_moduleKSheaf C
   380	  hdeg := hdeg
   381	  h1 := h1
   382	  P := rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L
   383	  hdense := dense_rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L
   384	  hPcl := ne_genericPoint_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage C
   385	  hPdeg := residueDeg_one_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage' C L
   386	  baseSubtraction := by
   387	    intro S _ _ hsupp
   388	    exact exists_baseSubtraction_of_supported_on_rationalPointBaseChangeImage C S hsupp
   389	
   390	/-- Immediate lambda-tied consumer of the rational-point-image package.
   391	
   392	The result contains the effective subtraction divisor, a base-field translating divisor,
   393	`h⁰ = 1`, preservation of `H¹ = 0`, the class-level base-change identity, and the existing
   394	`IsSplitWitness` for `μ` translated by that specific base-field class. -/
   395	theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropResult_of_rationalPointImage
   396	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   397	    (m : ℕ)
   398	    (M₀ : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
   399	    (hM₀ : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ) =
   400	      PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M₀))
   401	    (W₀ : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor)
   402	    (hW₀ : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W₀ =
   403	      M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   404	        (chartTwistClass C m (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)))
   405	    (excess : ℕ)
   406	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ = (genus C : ℤ) + excess)
   407	    (h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   408	      ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W₀) 1)) :
   409	    Nonempty (SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) μ
   410	      (sepClosedTranslatedDropDataOfRationalPointImage
   411	        μ m M₀ hM₀ W₀ hW₀ excess hdeg h1)) := by
   412	  exact exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropResult μ
   413	    (sepClosedTranslatedDropDataOfRationalPointImage
   414	      μ m M₀ hM₀ W₀ hW₀ excess hdeg h1)
   415	
   416	end DropPackage
   417	
   418	end AlgebraicGeometry

    11	/-!
    12	# The translated rank-one cover brick
    13	
    14	This file records the part of the separably-closed cover argument that is already consumable by
    15	the landed fibre API.  A `BaseFieldTranslationDrop` keeps the input class `lambda` in the
    16	presentation equation, chooses its base-field translating class explicitly, and records the
    17	positive-twist/point-subtraction output.  The consumer below turns that output into the exact
    18	`IsSplitWitness` shape used by `chartLocus`.
    19	
    20	The arbitrary-affine family of `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` objects required by
    21	`PicRankOneOpen` is deliberately not inferred from `h0 = 1` and `H1 = 0`: no such producer is
    22	landed in the current API.  The final theorem therefore exposes the field-level consumer and
    23	keeps that family producer as an explicit integration obligation.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	set_option autoImplicit false
    27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    28	
    29	universe u
    30	
    31	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    32	open TopologicalSpace Opposite
    33	
    34	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    35	
    36	open AlgebraicJacobian
    37	
    38	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    39	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    40	
    41	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    42	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    43	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    44	
    45	noncomputable section
    46	
    47	/-! ## The positive-twist input -/
    48	
    49	section PositiveTwist
    50	
    51	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y]
    52	  [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    53	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    54	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    55	  [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    56	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
    57	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 1)]
    58	
    59	/-- The FLV class theorem in the spelling used by the translated-cover lane.
    60	
    61	The class `l` is the presenting class of the input fibre, while `theta` is the positive
    62	base-field twist.  Keeping this as a named wrapper makes the positive-twist step visible at the
    63	call site; it does not manufacture a presentation or hide the input class in an unrelated
    64	existential. -/
    65	theorem exists_positive_twist_vanishing
    66	    (π : Y ⟶ P1 K) [IsFinite π] [IsDominant π]
    67	    (hπ : π ≫ P1.structureMap K = Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    68	    (l θ : Y.CechPic) (hθ : 1 ≤ classDeg K θ) :
    69	    ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ n₀, ∀ W : Y.CurveDivisor,
    70	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K W = l * θ ^ n →
    71	        Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K W) 1) := by
    72	  exact exists_subsingleton_hModule_one_of_one_le_classDeg_of_isFinite_toP1
    73	    π hπ l θ hθ
    74	
    75	end PositiveTwist
    76	
    77	/-! ## The lambda-tied drop package -/
    78	
    79	section DropPackage
    80	
    81	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    82	  [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
    83	  [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    84	
    85	/-- Data for the positive twist and the subsequent point subtraction.
    86	
    87	`hM₀` ties the splitting field presentation to the particular input `mu`; `hW₀` says that the
    88	divisor being reduced is in the positive twist class (the chart index is zero at this stage).
    89	`baseSubtraction` is intentionally an explicit class-level bridge: it says that the divisor
    90	returned by the greedy reduction is represented by a base-field divisor.  The current tree has
    91	the graph-class version of this bridge but no divisor pullback operation, so this hypothesis is
    92	kept visible rather than replaced by a fieldwise existential. -/
    93	structure SepClosedTranslatedDropData (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K)) where
    94	  m : ℕ
    95	  M₀ : (relCurve C L).CechPic
    96	  hM₀ : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ) =
    97	    PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M₀)
    98	  W₀ : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor
    99	  hW₀ : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W₀ =
   100	    M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   101	      (chartTwistClass C m (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor))
   102	  genusValue : ℕ
   103	  excess : ℕ
   104	  hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (genusValue : ℤ)
   105	  hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ = (genusValue : ℤ) + excess
   106	  h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   107	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W₀) 1)
   108	  P : Set ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   109	  hdense : ∀ U : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).Opens,
   110	    (U : Set ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)).Nonempty → (P ∩ U).Nonempty
   111	  hPcl : ∀ x ∈ P, x ≠ genericPoint ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   112	  hPdeg : ∀ x ∈ P, ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).residueDeg L x = 1
   113	  baseSubtraction : ∀ (S : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
   114	    0 ≤ S → Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L S = (excess : ℤ) →
   115	      (∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint _),
   116	        coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ P) →
   117	      ∃ Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor,
   118	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   119	          Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   120	            ((chartTwistClass C 0 Z)⁻¹)
   121	
   122	/-- The output of the positive-twist/drop construction, tied to both the input class and the
   123	base-field translating divisor.
   124	
   125	The final field is the existing fibre consumer.  In particular, `S` is not merely a divisor
   126	with the right cohomology: `baseClass` identifies its class with the base change of `Z`, and
   127	`translated` is about `mu` translated by the resulting base-field class
   128	`chartTwistClass C d.m Z`. -/
   129	structure SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   130	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ) where
   131	  S : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor
   132	  Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor
   133	  nonnegative : 0 ≤ S
   134	  degree : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L S = (d.excess : ℤ)
   135	  support : ∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint _),
   136	    coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ d.P
   137	  baseClass : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   138	    Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) ((chartTwistClass C 0 Z)⁻¹)
   139	  h0_one : Sheaf.h0
   140	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L (d.W₀ - S)) = 1
   141	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   142	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L (d.W₀ - S)) 1)
   143	  translated : IsSplitWitness C
   144	    (μ * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C d.m Z) (overSpec k K))
   145	
   146	/-- Positive twisting followed by point subtraction produces the exact field-level translated
   147	rank-one witness.
   148	
   149	The greedy theorem supplies `S`, `h0 = 1`, and preservation of `H1 = 0`.  The explicit
   150	`baseSubtraction` bridge then supplies the base divisor `Z`; class arithmetic shows that
   151	`W₀ - S` presents `mu` translated by the base-field class `chartTwistClass C d.m Z`.  The last
   152	line applies the existing `IsSplitWitness` consumer, so no unrelated Picard class can satisfy
   153	the conclusion. -/
   154	theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropResult
   155	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   156	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ) :
   157	    Nonempty (SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) μ d) := by
   158	  obtain ⟨-, S, hS0, hSdeg, hSsupport, hS0one, hS1⟩ :=
   159	    exists_isSplitWitness_of_drop C μ d.m
   160	      (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   161	      d.genusValue d.excess d.hχ d.M₀ d.hM₀ d.W₀ d.hW₀ d.hdeg d.h1
   162	      d.P d.hdense d.hPcl d.hPdeg
   163	  obtain ⟨Z, hSZ⟩ := d.baseSubtraction S hS0 hSdeg hSsupport
   164	  have hW : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L (d.W₀ - S) =
   165	      d.M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   166	        (chartTwistClass C d.m Z) := by
   167	    have hW₀ := d.hW₀
   168	    unfold relCurveMap relCurve at hW₀ hSZ ⊢
   169	    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_add, Scheme.picClass_neg,
   170	      hW₀, hSZ]
   171	    simp only [map_inv, inv_inv]
   172	    rw [mul_assoc, ← map_mul]
   173	    simp only [chartTwistClass, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_zero, inv_one, mul_one,
   174	      pow_zero, one_mul]
   175	  have htranslated : IsSplitWitness C
   176	      (μ * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C d.m Z) (overSpec k K)) :=
   177	    isSplitWitness_of_witness_twistClass C μ d.m Z d.M₀ d.hM₀
   178	      (d.W₀ - S) hW hS1
   179	  exact ⟨{
   180	    S := S
   181	    Z := Z
   182	    nonnegative := hS0
   183	    degree := hSdeg
   184	    support := hSsupport
   185	    baseClass := hSZ
   186	    h0_one := hS0one
   187	    h1_vanishing := hS1
   188	    translated := htranslated
   189	  }⟩
   190	
   191	end DropPackage
   192	
   193	end
   194	
   195	end AlgebraicGeometry

    10	/-!
    11	# Effective residual representatives for the translated rank-one cover
    12	
    13	The greedy translated-drop package records `h⁰ = 1` for `W₀ - S`, but it does not
    14	assert that this chosen divisor is effective.  A positive global section nevertheless
    15	produces an effective representative of the same class.  This file exposes that
    16	representative with its degree-genus certificate, while retaining the input class and
    17	the existing translated `IsSplitWitness` consumer.
    18	-/
    19	
    20	set_option autoImplicit false
    21	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    22	
    23	universe u
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    26	open TopologicalSpace Opposite
    27	
    28	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    29	
    30	open AlgebraicJacobian
    31	
    32	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    33	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    34	
    35	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k]
    36	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    37	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    38	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    39	
    40	noncomputable section
    41	
    42	section ResidualRepresentative
    43	
    44	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    45	  [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
    46	  [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    47	
    48	/-! The product curve instances are the same base-change package used by the
    49	general producer.  `exists_effective_of_h0_pos` does not require the finite
    50	cohomology instances, so this bridge only installs the geometric hypotheses. -/
    51	
    52	omit [IsSepClosed k] [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L] in
    53	theorem exists_effective_residual_degree_genus
    54	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
    55	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ)
    56	    (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) μ d) :
    57	    ∃ E : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor,
    58	      0 ≤ E ∧
    59	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L E = (d.genusValue : ℤ) ∧
    60	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L E =
    61	          Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L (d.W₀ - r.S) := by
    62	  haveI : IsIntegral (relCurve C L) := instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
    63	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
    64	      (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    65	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
    66	  haveI : QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
    67	    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
    68	  have hpos : 0 < Sheaf.h0
    69	      ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L (d.W₀ - r.S)) := by
    70	    rw [r.h0_one]
    71	    norm_num
    72	  obtain ⟨E, hE, hEc⟩ :=
    73	    exists_effective_of_h0_pos (K := L) (d.W₀ - r.S) hpos
    74	  have hdegResidual : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L (d.W₀ - r.S) =
    75	      (d.genusValue : ℤ) := by
    76	    rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' L, d.hdeg, r.degree]
    77	    ring
    78	  exact ⟨E, hE,
    79	    (deg_eq_deg_of_picClass_eq (K := L) hEc).trans hdegResidual,
    80	    hEc⟩
    81	
    82	/-! The general consumer keeps the finite separable extension and the exact
    83	input class in scope, and adds the effective degree-genus representative to
    84	the already landed translated-drop result. -/
    85	
    86	theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropEffective_general
    87	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K)) :
    88	    ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra K L)
    89	        (_ : IsScalarTower k K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L)
    90	        (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L)
    91	        (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ)
    92	        (r : SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) μ d)
    93	        (E : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
    94	      0 ≤ E ∧
    95	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L E = (d.genusValue : ℤ) ∧
    96	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L E =
    97	          Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L (d.W₀ - r.S) ∧
    98	        IsSplitWitness C
    99	          (μ * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C d.m r.Z) (overSpec k K)) := by
   100	  obtain ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d, ⟨r⟩⟩ :=
   101	    exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropResult_general (C := C) μ
   102	  letI := hLfield
   103	  letI := hkL
   104	  letI := hKL
   105	  letI := htow
   106	  letI := hfin
   107	  letI := hsep
   108	  obtain ⟨E, hE, hEdeg, hEclass⟩ :=
   109	    exists_effective_residual_degree_genus μ d r
   110	  exact ⟨L, hLfield, hkL, hKL, htow, hfin, hsep, d, r, E,
   111	    hE, hEdeg, hEclass, r.translated⟩
   112	
   113	end ResidualRepresentative
   114	
   115	end
   116	
   117	end AlgebraicGeometry

    15	`PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf`, and `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies its
    16	restriction to the coefficient ring with the original datum sheaf.
    17	
    18	This is deliberately only the native-module bridge.  It does not assert
    19	`IsLineBundle`, pushforward base-change, or existence of a tied
    20	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation`; those remain genuine producer obligations.

    44	The action is the componentwise multiplication action; the four module laws

    53	    ⟨fun r s => gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s⟩
    54	  exact Module.ofMinimalAxioms
    55	    (fun r x y => gluedQsmul_add B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x y)
    56	    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_add_left B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    57	    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_mul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
    58	    (fun x => gluedQsmul_one B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) x)
    59	
    60	/-- The presheaf of structure-sheaf modules underlying `D`. -/
    61	noncomputable def nativePresheaf : (relCurve C B).PresheafOfModules := by
    62	  let M : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat :=
    63	    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)
    64	  let family : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
    65	      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) :=
    66	    fun U => moduleOn D U.unop
    67	  letI : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
    68	      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) := family
    69	  exact PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf M (by
    70	    intro X Y f r m
    71	    change gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le
    72	        (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : X.unop ≤ X.unop) r m) =
    73	      gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : Y.unop ≤ Y.unop)
    74	        ((relCurve C B).resHom f.unop.le r)
    75	        (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le m)
    76	    rw [gluedRes_gluedQsmul]
    77	    apply Subtype.ext
    78	    funext j
    79	    rw [gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe]
    80	    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom])
    81	
    82	/-- The native `Scheme.Modules` object associated to a glued datum. -/
    83	noncomputable def nativeModule : (relCurve C B).Modules := by
    84	  refine ⟨nativePresheaf D, ?_⟩
    85	  rw [show (nativePresheaf D).presheaf =
    86	    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat) from rfl]
    87	  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    88	    (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
    89	  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    90	    (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} B))).mp D.sheaf.property using 1
    91	  all_goals rfl
    92	
    93	/-- On every open, restricting `D.nativeModule` to the coefficient ring recovers
    94	the datum's original module of sections.
    95	
    96	The equivalence is the identity on sections. Its linearity is the substantive
    97	point: `gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap` identifies the native structure-sheaf action
    98	of a coefficient scalar with the datum's coefficient action. -/
    99	noncomputable def nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv
   100	    (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
   101	    (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   102	      (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D)).obj.obj (op U) ≃ₗ[B]
   103	      D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) :=
   104	  LinearEquiv.ofBijective
   105	    { toFun := fun x => x
   106	      map_add' := by
   107	        intros
   108	        rfl
   109	      map_smul' := by
   110	        intro r x
   111	        change gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U)
   112	            ((relCurve C B).overAlgebraMap B U r) x =
   113	          r • (show D.sheaf.obj.obj (op U) from x)
   114	        exact gluedQsmul_overAlgebraMap B D.pieces D.unit
   115	          (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x }
   116	    ⟨fun _ _ h => h, fun y => ⟨y, rfl⟩⟩
   117	
   118	/-- The base-ring sheaf of `D.nativeModule` is canonically the datum sheaf.
   119	
   120	This has exactly the type of `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.module_iso` when the
   121	presentation's native module is chosen to be `D.nativeModule`. -/
   122	noncomputable def nativeModuleKSheafIso :
   123	    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   124	      (Over.mk (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))) (nativeModule D) ≅ D.sheaf :=
   125	  (fullyFaithfulSheafToPresheaf _ _).preimageIso
   126	    (NatIso.ofComponents
   127	      (fun U => (nativeModuleKSectionsEquiv D U.unop).toModuleIso)
   128	      (fun {_ _} _ => by
   129	        apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
   130	        apply LinearMap.ext
   131	        intro x
   132	        rfl))
   133	
   134	end
   135	
   136	end BasicOpenCocycleDatum
   137	
   138	end AlgebraicGeometry

+import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocus

+/-!
+# The native module carried by a glued rank-one datum
+
+`BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sheaf` is already a sheaf of modules over the coefficient
+ring.  The presentation contract also asks for the same object as a sheaf of
+modules over the structure sheaf of the relative curve.  This file supplies
+that type-level bridge: the componentwise `gluedQsmul` action gives a module on
+every open, and `gluedRes_gluedQsmul` gives the semilinearity needed by
+`PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf`.
+
+This is deliberately only the native-module bridge.  It does not assert
+`IsLineBundle`, pushforward base-change, or existence of a tied
+`PicRankOneLocalPresentation`; those remain genuine producer obligations.
+-/

+set_option autoImplicit false
+
+universe u
+
+open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
+
+namespace AlgebraicGeometry
+
+variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
+variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
+variable {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
+variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom pi]
+
+namespace BasicOpenCocycleDatum
+
+noncomputable section
+
+variable (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
+
+/-- The structure-sheaf module on the sections of the glued datum over one open.
+
+The action is the componentwise multiplication action; the four module laws
+are inherited from the corresponding `gluedQsmul` identities. -/
+@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleOn (U : (relCurve C B).Opens) :
+    Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
+      ((D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)).obj (op U)) := by
+  change Module Γ(relCurve C B, U)
+    (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U))
+  letI : SMul Γ(relCurve C B, U)
+      (↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit U)) :=
+    ⟨fun r s => gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s⟩
+  exact Module.ofMinimalAxioms
+    (fun r x y => gluedQsmul_add B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r x y)
+    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_add_left B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
+    (fun r s x => gluedQsmul_mul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) r s x)
+    (fun x => gluedQsmul_one B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : U ≤ U) x)
+
+/-- The presheaf of structure-sheaf modules underlying `D`. -/
+noncomputable def nativePresheaf : (relCurve C B).PresheafOfModules := by
+  let M : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat :=
+    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat)
+  let family : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
+      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) :=
+    fun U => moduleOn D U.unop
+  letI : ∀ U : (relCurve C B).Opensᵒᵖ,
+      Module ((relCurve C B).ringCatSheaf.obj.obj U) (M.obj U) := family
+  exact PresheafOfModules.ofPresheaf M (by
+    intro X Y f r m
+    change gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le
+        (gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : X.unop ≤ X.unop) r m) =
+      gluedQsmul B D.pieces D.unit (le_rfl : Y.unop ≤ Y.unop)
+        ((relCurve C B).resHom f.unop.le r)
+        (gluedRes B D.pieces D.unit f.unop.le m)
+    rw [gluedRes_gluedQsmul]
+    apply Subtype.ext
+    funext j
+    rw [gluedQsmul_coe, gluedQsmul_coe]
+    simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom])
+
+/-- The native `Scheme.Modules` object associated to a glued datum. -/

+  refine ⟨nativePresheaf D, ?_⟩
+  rw [show (nativePresheaf D).presheaf =
+    D.sheaf.obj ⋙ (forget₂ (ModuleCat B) AddCommGrpCat) from rfl]
+  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
+    (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})]
+  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
+    (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} B))).mp D.sheaf.property using 1
+  all_goals rfl
+
+end
+
+end BasicOpenCocycleDatum

    15	
    16	/-!
    17	# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
    18	
    19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
    20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
    21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
    22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
    23	
    24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
    25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
    26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
    27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
    28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
    29	
    30	No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
    31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
    32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
    33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
    34	datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
    35	the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.
    36	-/
    37	
    38	set_option autoImplicit false
    39	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    40	
    41	universe u
    42	
    43	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite MonoidalCategory
    44	  CartesianMonoidalCategory
    45	
    46	open scoped TensorProduct
    47	
    48	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    49	
    50	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    51	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver
    52	
    53	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    54	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    55	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    56	variable {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    57	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    58	
    59	/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.
    60	
    61	The two equality fields prevent an unrelated cocycle datum or line bundle from serving as a
    62	witness: `representative` presents the input plus class, `datum_class` presents that same
    63	relative Picard class, and `module_iso` identifies the resulting cocycle sheaf with the
    64	underlying base-ring sheaf of `module`. -/
    65	structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    66	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    67	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    68	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    69	  represents :
    70	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    71	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    72	  datum_class :
    73	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    74	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    75	  module : (relCurve C cover.Carrier).Modules
    76	  module_iso :
    77	    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
    78	      (Over.mk (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier))) module ≅ datum.sheaf
    79	  line_bundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle module
    80	  native_pushforward_base_change :
    81	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    82	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    83	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
    84	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    85	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
    86	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app module)
    87	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
    88	  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    89	  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    90	  h0_rank_one :
    91	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
    92	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1
    93	
    94	namespace PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    95	
    96	variable {pi} {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
    97	
    98	noncomputable local instance presentationModuleSections
    99	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) (U : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens) :
   100	    Module P.cover.Carrier Γ(P.module, U) :=
   101	  Scheme.moduleKSections
   102	    (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))) P.module U
   103	
   104	/-- The canonical `H^0` base-change equivalence attached to a rank-one presentation.
   105	
   106	This is derived from `P.h1_vanishing`; it is not an independently chosen witness. -/
   107	noncomputable def h0BaseChange (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   108	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   109	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   110	    B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] (Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B]
   111	      Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0 :=
   112	  P.datum.datumH0BaseChange B
   113	    ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing)
   114	
   115	/-- The canonical evaluation map attached to a tied local rank-one presentation. -/
   116	noncomputable def evaluation (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
   117	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   118	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj
   119	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   120	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ⟶
   121	      P.module :=
   122	  (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   123	    (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module
   124	
   125	/-! ## Native pushforward base change and evaluation coherence -/
   126	
   127	/-- The canonical native pushforward base-change isomorphism supplied by the presentation.
   128	
   129	The isomorphism is not chosen independently: its hom is definitionally
   130	`(canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module`. -/
   131	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   132	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   133	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   134	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   135	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   136	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   137	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
   138	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   139	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   140	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) := by
   141	  exact @asIso _ _ _ _ ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module)
   142	    (P.native_pushforward_base_change g f' g' sq)
   143	
   144	/-- The native pushforward base-change isomorphism for an affine coefficient extension. -/
   145	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIsoAffine (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   146	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   147	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   148	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   149	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier B)))).obj
   150	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   151	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   152	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   153	        (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))).obj
   154	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) :=
   155	  P.nativeBaseChangeIso
   156	    (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
   157	    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   158	    (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
   159	    (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))
   160	
   161	/-- The source of evaluation identifies canonically with the source of evaluation after any
   162	cartesian base change. -/
   163	noncomputable def evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   164	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   165	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   166	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   167	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   168	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   169	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   170	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⋙
   171	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj
   172	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   173	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   174	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback f').obj
   175	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) :=
   176	  ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   177	    Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   178	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   179	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).app
   180	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   181	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)).symm) ≪≫
   182	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').mapIso (P.nativeBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq)
   183	
   184	/-- Under the source identification, evaluation after base change is the pullback of the
   185	presentation's original evaluation counit. -/
   186	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
   187	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   188	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   189	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   190	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   191	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   192	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   193	    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq).hom ≫
   194	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   195	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) =
   196	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map P.evaluation := by
   197	  change ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   198	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   199	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   200	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).inv).app
   201	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   202	            (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)) ≫
   203	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module) ≫
   204	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   205	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module)) =
   206	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
   207	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   208	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module)
   209	  exact canonicalBaseChangeMap_counit_cancel sq P.module
   210	
   211	/-! The affine coefficient-extension spelling of the evaluation/base-change contract.
   212	
   213	This is the consumer-facing specialization for the future zero-locus construction: it keeps
   214	the coefficient ring `B` and `relCurveMap` explicit while retaining the canonical cartesian
   215	square, rather than introducing a second base-change witness. -/
   216	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIsoAffine_hom_evaluation
   217	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   218	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   219	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   220	    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso
   221	      (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
   222	      (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   223	      (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
   224	      (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C
   225	        (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))).hom ≫
   226	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   227	          (snd C (overSpec k B)).left).counit.app
   228	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) =
   229	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).map P.evaluation := by
   230	  exact P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation

     9	/-!
    10	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
    11	
    12	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
    13	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
    14	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
    15	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
    16	
    17	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
    18	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
    19	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
    21	the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    30	
    31	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    32	
    33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    34	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    35	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    36	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    37	
    38	noncomputable section
    39	
    40	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
    41	
    42	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
    43	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
    44	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
    45	def PicRankOneOpen :
    46	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
    47	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    48	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    49	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    50	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
    51	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
    52	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    53	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
    54	      apply Subtype.ext
    55	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    56	    rw [e]
    57	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)
    58	
    59	/-! ## The public membership contract -/
    60	
    61	/-- The exact producer predicate for the rank-one locus.
    62	
    63	This is intentionally lambda-tied and quantifies over every affine pullback.  In particular, it
    64	is stronger than a field-fibre `h⁰ = 1`/`H¹ = 0` statement: a producer must supply the complete
    65	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` structure for the pulled-back class. -/
    66	def PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition
    67	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    68	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) : Prop :=
    69	  ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    70	    (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    71	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    72	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))
    73	
    74	/-- Unfolded membership in `PicRankOneOpen`, with the presentation tied to the pulled-back
    75	Picard class.  Keeping this predicate named is important for producers in later lanes: a
    76	field-level divisor or chart witness is not a substitute for this arbitrary-affine-pullback
    77	contract. -/
    78	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_iff {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    79	    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) :
    80	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔
    81	      ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    82	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    83	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    84	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam)) := by
    85	  rfl
    86	
    87	/-- Constructor for the exact lambda-tied arbitrary-affine-pullback presentation contract. -/
    88	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations
    89	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    90	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    91	    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    92	        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    93	        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    94	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
    95	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
    96	  (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mpr h
    97	
    98	/-- Constructor using the named arbitrary-affine producer predicate. -/
    99	theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentationCondition
   100	    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   101	    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   102	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition pi lam) :
   103	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
   104	  exact mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi h
   105	
   106	/-- The inclusion of the public rank-one locus into its degree-genus ambient functor. -/
   107	def picRankOneOpenIncl :
   108	    (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ) :=
   109	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   110	
   111	/-- The same inclusion after the slice-to-big-site `Σ` extension.
   112	
   113	`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is a property of presheaves on schemes.  The rank-one functor is
   114	defined on the slice over `Spec k`, so the `Σ` extension is the category-correct carrier for the
   115	relative-open gate below. -/
   116	def picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl :
   117	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶
   118	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
   119	  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι
   120	
   121	/-- Relative openness of the public locus, in Mathlib's presheaf sense.
   122	
   123	This is a named acceptance gate rather than an unproved global assertion.  A future geometric
   124	producer discharges it by supplying the represented open pullbacks; no arbitrary `Subfunctor` is
   125	silently treated as an open subscheme. -/
   126	def PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen : Prop :=
   127	  IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi)
   128	
   129	/-! ## The explicit fibre producer contract -/
   130	
   131	/-- A fibre of the rank-one locus over one test class, presented by an open of that test.
   132	
   133	The `exists_factor` field is tied to the displayed class `g` and to an arbitrary source value `v`.
   134	It is the family-level content needed for relative representability; the open immersion itself
   135	supplies uniqueness of the factor.  Thus this structure cannot be inhabited by an unrelated open
   136	or by a fieldwise dimension statement. -/
   137	structure PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   138	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
   139	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   140	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))) where
   141	  W : X.Opens
   142	  fst : yoneda.obj (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   143	    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
   144	  sq : fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g
   145	  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u})
   146	    (v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (Opposite.op S))
   147	    (w : S ⟶ X),
   148	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (Opposite.op S) v =
   149	      g.app (Opposite.op S) w →
   150	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}),
   151	      fst.app (Opposite.op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w
   152	
   153	namespace PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   154	
   155	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
   156	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   157	  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))}
   158	
   159	/-- The fibre square supplied by `FibrePresented` is a pullback of presheaves. -/
   160	theorem isPullback (D : PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
   161	    IsPullback D.fst (yoneda.map D.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g := by
   162	  refine IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app fun S => ?_
   163	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff]
   164	  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
   165	  · exact congrArg (fun φ : yoneda.obj (D.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
   166	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) =>
   167	      φ.app S) D.sq
   168	  · rintro u₁ u₂ ⟨-, h₂⟩
   169	    exact (cancel_mono D.W.ι).mp h₂
   170	  · intro v w hvw
   171	    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := D.exists_factor S.unop v w hvw
   172	    exact ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩
   173	
   174	end PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
   175	
   176	/-- An arbitrary-test fibre producer discharges the relative openness gate. -/
   177	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented
   178	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   179	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   180	        Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))),
   181	      PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
   182	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
   183	  refine MorphismProperty.relative.of_exists ?_
   184	  intro X g
   185	  let d := D X g
   186	  exact ⟨d.W, d.fst, d.W.ι, d.isPullback, inferInstance⟩
   187	
   188	/-- Expose a supplied relative-open certificate without hiding it behind typeclass search. -/
   189	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_certificate
   190	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi) : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi :=
   191	  h
   192	
   193	/-- Extract the open immersion supplied by the relative-openness certificate on an arbitrary
   194	pullback.  This is the exact shape consumed by an eventual chart/fibre producer. -/
   195	theorem picRankOneOpen_openPullback
   196	    (h : PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi)
   197	    {X Z : Scheme.{u}}
   198	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
   199	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)))
   200	    (fst : yoneda.obj Z ⟶
   201	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor)
   202	    (snd : Z ⟶ X)
   203	    (hpb : IsPullback fst (yoneda.map snd) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g) :
   204	    IsOpenImmersion snd :=
   205	  h.property g fst snd hpb
   206	
   207	/-- Pullback stability of the public rank-one locus, exposed independently of its definition. -/
   208	theorem picRankOneOpen_map_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   209	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   210	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
   211	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
   212	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).map f h
   213	
   214	/-- Pullback stability of the public locus, with the base-change direction made explicit. -/
   215	theorem picRankOneOpen_baseChange_mem {T T' : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
   216	    (f : T ⟶ T') {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
   217	    (h : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T) :
   218	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map f lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T' :=
   219	  picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi f h
   220	
   221	/-- The inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` under the affine widened Abel transformation.
   222	
   223	This name deliberately records only a presentation-theoretic preimage.  It is not the future
   224	open subscheme `DivRankOneOpen`. -/
   225	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff :
   226	    Subfunctor (divFunctorAff C (genus C)) :=
   227	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).preimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))

     9	/-!
    10	# COVERAGE NEEDS NO DROP, NO ORACLE, AND NO STEP 6
    11	
    12	A retraction of this lane's own account of B-5, and it removes a residue rather than adding one.
    13	
    14	`Picard/Pic0ChartCoverageTest.lean`'s DEFECT section establishes — correctly — that the
    15	`w4-datb` §1.2 argument as written runs the greedy drop at `Z := 0` and feeds the drop's
    16	**output** `Σ` back as the chart index's `Z`, so that the two stages carry different `Z`, and
    17	that this feedback ("step 6") is not discharged anywhere.  It records step 6 as one of B-5's
    18	open residues.
    19	
    20	**Step 6 is not a residue, because coverage does not need the drop at all.**
    21	
    22	## Why: read what `chartLocus` actually asks for
    23	
    24	`IsSplitWitness` (`Pic0ChartLocus.lean:151`) — and its own docstring says this at length, under
    25	"A convention this predicate INHERITS" — asks for a divisor `W` in the presenting class with
    26	`Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(W))`, and asks for **neither `0 ≤ W` nor `deg W = g`**.  Effectivity and the
    27	degree normalisation are what the *chart map's injectivity* needs (GAP-2, `h⁰ = 1`), not what
    28	*membership of the locus* needs.
    29	
    30	The drop (`RiemannRoch/CoverageDrop.lean`) exists to manufacture exactly those two extra
    31	properties: it takes a degree-`g+e` witness with `h¹ = 0` and produces an effective `S` with
    32	`h⁰(W₀ − S) = 1`.  For membership, that work is thrown away — `mem_chartLocus_of_drop` returns
    33	the `IsSplitWitness` half from `hW₀`/`h1` alone, and its own proof shows this: the split witness
    34	comes from `isSplitWitness_of_witness_twistClass C μ m Z M₀ hM₀ W₀ hW₀ h1`, in which the drop,
    35	the oracle `P`, `hdense`, `hPcl`, `hPdeg`, `g`, `e`, `hχ` and `hdeg` **do not appear**.
    36	
    37	So the feedback of step 6 was an artefact of routing coverage through the drop.  Cut the drop
    38	and there is one `Z` again — the chart index's — and nothing to feed back.
    39	
    40	## What coverage then needs, in full
    41	
    42	Exactly one input beyond the landed splitting: a divisor of the twisted fibre class over the
    43	splitting field with vanishing `H¹`.  That is DAT-0a at the fibre field, and it is genuinely
    44	per-fibre (I-0204, `w4-datb` §0.2.2): no uniform `m₀` exists, so the exponent `m` must be chosen
    45	against `L`'s own threshold `b_L`.
    46	
    47	**CORRECTED 2026-07-30 in its second sentence** (`Picard/Pic0ChartCoverageThreshold.lean`,
    48	inbox `I-1329`).  The *threshold* is not per-fibre.  I-0204 says the per-field ledger
    49	**constants** do not transport — true — but the vanishing bound induced at `L` is base-field
    50	data: `subsingleton_hModule_one_of_witness` (`RiemannRoch/WindowFieldTransport.lean:87`) is
    51	π-free, `windowN C L hπ g` is a witness at every `L`, and `deg_windowN = M·δ` with
    52	`windowM_choice`/`windowδ` computed at `k`.  So `M·δ + g` is **one threshold for every
    53	splitting field**.
    54	
    55	**TWO CORRECTIONS TO THAT CORRECTION, both the same day** (audit + author reproduction, inbox
    56	`I-1349`/`I-1350`), so read the paragraph above only for its central point:

110	/-! ## The split witness predicate at a class over a field -/
   111	
   112	variable (C) in
   113	/-- **The split witness predicate** (CHART-U(a) in the `w4-datb` §1.6 (a-amendment)
   114	spelling), at a plus class `μ` over a field `K`.
   115	
   116	A plus class over a field need not be an honest Čech class — it is `PicEtAff.mk E x` for
   117	an étale cover `E` of `K`.  The amendment's "for some finite separable `L/κ(t)` splitting
   118	the collapsed plus class" is this: there is a finite separable extension `L/K` over which
   119	`μ` becomes `relPicMk` of an honest Čech class `M` on `C_L`, and `M` admits an effective
   120	witness divisor with vanishing `H¹`.
   121	
   122	Stated with the witness clause on a *presenting Čech class* rather than on a datum,
   123	because the datum layer is where the shifted-datum constructor (DAT-C GAP-1) is missing;
   124	the two agree through `Pic0ChartLocusClass.mem_cechWitnessLocus_iff_exists`.
   125	
   126	## A convention this predicate INHERITS, and which a consumer must not misread
   127	
   128	The worksheets say "effective degree-`g` witness with `h¹ = 0`".  The witness clause here —
   129	and the tree's `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.HasWitnessH1Vanishing`
   130	(`Pic0ChartLocusFibreField.lean:115`) that it mirrors, and the GAP-6 dictionary
   131	`subsingleton_h1_tensor_iff_exists_witness` (`DivisorFamilyH1Locus.lean:182`) that both rest
   132	on — asks for **neither `0 ≤ W` nor `deg W = g`**.  It asks only for a `CurveDivisor` in the
   133	class with vanishing `H¹`.  That is deliberate on the tree's side: the dictionary is an *iff*
   134	against the engine's complex-form condition `Subsingleton (H¹(pair D) ⊗ L)`, and that
   135	condition cannot see effectivity or degree, so adding either clause would break the iff and
   136	with it the openness route.
   137	
   138	Two consequences, both load-bearing:
   139	
   140	* the degree is supplied **externally**, by the chart-index constraint through
   141	  `degAt_chartTwist` below: on a degree-zero `λ` the twisted class has fibre degree
   142	  `m·d₁ − deg Z`, which the constraint `deg Z = m·d₁ − g` makes `+g`.  It is *not* a
   143	  hypothesis of this predicate.  (Until 2026-07-28 this read `−g`, and that sign made the
   144	  locus empty for every `g ≥ 1` — see `degAt_chartTwist` and issue I-0514;
   145	  `chartTwist_chartValue` now pins the direction by the kernel);
   146	* effectivity likewise is not asserted here.  Where the *worksheet's* stronger reading is
   147	  actually needed — the canonical-section normalization `h⁰ = 1`, and GAP-2 uniqueness
   148	  (`Scheme.CurveDivisor.eq_of_picClass_eq_of_h0_one`, which does take `0 ≤ D`, `0 ≤ D'`) — the
   149	  effectivity must be re-supplied at that point.  A lane that reads `IsSplitWitness` as
   150	  already giving it will have a gap where it least expects one. -/
   151	def IsSplitWitness {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   152	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K)) : Prop :=
   153	  ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (_ : Algebra k L) (_ : Algebra K L)
   154	      (_ : IsScalarTower k K L) (_ : Module.Finite K L) (_ : Algebra.IsSeparable K L)
   155	      (M : (relCurve C L).CechPic),
   156	    PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ)
   157	        = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M)
   158	      ∧ ∃ W : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor,
   159	          Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W = M
   160	            ∧ Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   161	                ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W) 1)

   163	/-! ## The twisted fibre family -/
   164	
   165	variable (C) in
   166	/-- **The twisted family whose chart-membership `chartLocus` tests**: the plus class `λ`
   167	shifted by the Σ-family of `Z` and by `m` inverse powers of the pinned θ-family.
   168	
   169	This is the *class-side* half of `chartValue` (`Picard/DivSchemeAbel.lean:351`): where
   170	`chartValue` twists the Abel class of a divisor family, `chartTwist` twists an arbitrary
   171	plus class by the same two factors.  A point of `chartLocus` is precisely a point at which
   172	`chartTwist` is realised by an effective divisor with no `H¹` — i.e. at which `λ` itself is
   173	a chart value, after undoing the twist. -/
   174	def chartTwist (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   175	    (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) (lam : picEt C T) : picEt C T :=
   176	  lam * (thetaFamily C (thetaCechClass C) T ^ m) * (sigmaFamily C Z T)⁻¹
   177	
   178	/-- **The degree ledger of the twist**: at every field point the twisted family has fibre
   179	degree `m·d₁ − deg Z` when `λ` is degree-zero.  With the chart-index constraint
   180	`deg Z = m·d₁ − g` this is `+g`, which is the degree at which an effective witness with
   181	`h¹ = 0` can exist at all.
   182	
   183	**Sign discipline, and it was wrong here until 2026-07-28 (issue I-0514).**  `chartTwist`
   184	must be the INVERSE of `chartValue`'s twist, not the same one.  `chartValue` is
   185	`abelDiv · Σ · (θᵐ)⁻¹` (`DivSchemeAbel.lean:351`), so recovering the Abel class from a chart
   186	value means multiplying by `θᵐ` and dividing by `Σ` — hence `chartTwist` is
   187	`λ · θᵐ · Σ⁻¹`.  An earlier version applied the `chartValue` twist itself, giving fibre degree
   188	`deg Z − m·d₁ = −g`; since `Subsingleton H¹(𝒪(W))` forces `deg W ≥ g − 1`, that locus was
   189	**empty for every `g ≥ 1`** and its openness was the openness of `∅`.  The comparison point is
   190	`degAt_chartValue` at `n = g` (where the chart index is calibrated and `chartValue` lands in
   191	`pic0`), NOT at `n = 0`.
   192	
   193	**An independent confirmation that `+g` is the right target**, worth recording because the
   194	wrong sign survived two sessions: at `deg W = g` the rank anchor
   195	`h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one` (`RiemannRoch/FLVClass.lean:412`) gives, for a
   196	witness with `h¹ = 0`,
   197	`h⁰ = deg W + χ(𝒪) = g + (1 − g) = 1` — exactly the `h⁰ = 1` normalization that DAT-C §2 and
   198	GAP-2's uniqueness both require.  So `+g` is not merely the sign that makes the locus nonempty;
   199	it is the unique degree at which the witness is *unique*, which is what the chart map needs to be
   200	injective.  At `−g` the same anchor gives `h⁰ = 1 − 2g`, negative for `g ≥ 1` — the contradiction
   201	that made the locus empty. -/
   202	theorem degAt_chartTwist (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   203	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} {lam : picEt C T} (hlam : lam ∈ pic0Subgroup C T)
   204	    {K : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K] (t : overSpec k K ⟶ T) :
   205	    degAt (chartTwist C m Z T lam) t
   206	      = (m : ℤ) * classDeg k (thetaCechClass C) - Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg k Z := by
   207	  rw [chartTwist, degAt_mul, degAt_inv, degAt_mul, degAt_thetaFamily_pow,
   208	    degAt_sigmaFamily, (mem_pic0Subgroup_iff.mp hlam) K t]
   209	  ring
   210	
   211	/-- **`chartTwist` inverts `chartValue`'s twist** — the sign check, as a theorem rather than a
   212	docstring claim.
   213	
   214	Applying `chartTwist` to a chart value returns the Abel class it came from.  This is the
   215	statement that was FALSE of the earlier definition (which returned
   216	`abelDiv · Σ² · (θᵐ)⁻²`), and it is why the direction is now pinned by the kernel: any future
   217	edit to `chartTwist` that breaks the inversion breaks this lemma.
   218	
   219	Recorded per issue I-0514.  A degree ledger alone does not catch a sign error — the wrong-signed
   220	ledger was internally consistent — but an inversion law does. -/
   221	theorem chartTwist_chartValue {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ)
   222	    (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor) (T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   223	    (s : divFamZar C π n T) :
   224	    chartTwist C m Z T (chartValue C π n m Z T s) = abelDiv C π n T s := by
   225	  rw [chartTwist, chartValue]

   231	/-- **CHART-U(a), `chartLocus`** (`w4-datc` §3.3, co-signed `w4-datb` §1.6): the set of

   233	some finite separable splitting of the collapsed plus class at `κ(t)`, an effective witness
   234	divisor with vanishing `H¹`.
   235	
   236	The three layers, each supplied by a named brick:
   237	* the *point-to-field-point* passage is `Over.testPoint` (input 0 of this brick — the one
   238	  nothing in the tree had);
   239	* the *twist* is `chartTwist`, the class-side avatar of `chartValue`;

   242	This is the RESERVED name of `Pic0ChartLocusClass.lean`'s header, now defined.  Note it is
   243	strictly stronger than `cechWitnessLocus`: general test, twisted class, split predicate. -/
   244	def chartLocus (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   245	    {T : Over (Spec (.of k))} (lam : picEt C T) : Set T.left :=
   246	  {t : T.left | IsSplitWitness C
   247	    (picEtMap C (Over.testPoint t) (chartTwist C m Z T lam))}

   258	The tree's *engine-facing* predicate is stated on a `BasicOpenCocycleDatum`
